description: Agent-mode Marvin is about to write analyst outputs for a Jira story.
why_this_matters: The branch is the ticket key plus a slug of the user story. Marvin creates that branch, switches onto it, and runs the rest of the turn there. The pattern example is not a branch name. Creating the ref without switching, or switching back, leaves Marvin on the previous branch.

input.user_prompt: /marvin Ticket: ECCS-4521. User story: Implement this or that. Sources: @spec.md. Carry this through implementation.
input.context: Agent mode. The ticket key is ECCS-4521. The user story title is Implement this or that. No requirements files exist yet. The current branch is main and the working tree has unrelated uncommitted files. story-branch.py prints ECCS-4521-implement-this-or-that. That local branch does not exist yet. After creation, Marvin must be on ECCS-4521-implement-this-or-that for the analyst and any later stage in the turn. Remaining on main, creating the branch with git branch alone, or switching back to main, fails the scenario.

missing_title.context: Agent mode. No user story title was supplied and no Jira summary is available.
